author: SnowSX3
body:
A profile is completely about you, the player.
So shouldn't the most personalised part of your profile be the default page?

Should the "About" section of someone's profile be the first thing you see when you go onto a profile? Or are the stats section OK?

Personally, I'd prefer the "About" section to be the default as your profile would start with who you are as a player.

What are your thoughts?

replies.author: _DC
replies.body:
It's a no from me.

I wouldn't like this. I am just a pixelated face, behind which could be anyone. I would like that to stay the way it is, or as close to that as it can be. I would prefer that you looked at my stats from the server before a few random sentences that may or may not be about myself.
